question.en: What happened when the snake charmer began to play jazz?
question.zh: 耍蛇人吹起爵士乐时发生了什么？

sentences.en: What happened when the snake charmer began to play jazz?
sentences.zh: 耍蛇人吹起爵士乐时发生了什么？

sentences.en: As we had had a long walk through one of the markets of old Delhi,
sentences.zh: 我们在旧德里的一个市场里走了很久，

sentences.en: we stopped at a square to have a rest.
sentences.zh: 就在一个广场上停下来休息。

sentences.en: After a time, we noticed a snake charmer with two large baskets at the other side of the square,
sentences.zh: 过了一会儿，我们注意到广场另一头有个耍蛇人，身边放着两个大篮子，

sentences.en: so we went to have a look at him.
As soon as he saw us,
he picked up a long pipe which was covered with coins and opened one of the baskets.
sentences.zh: 就拿起一根镶着硬币的长笛，打开了其中一个篮子。

sentences.en: When he began to play a tune,
we had our first glimpse of the snake.
sentences.zh: 我们第一次瞥见了那条蛇。

sentences.en: It rose out of the basket and began to follow the movements of the pipe.
sentences.zh: 它从篮子里探出身子，开始随着笛子的动作舞动。

sentences.en: We were very much surprised when the snake charmer
sentences.zh: 我们非常惊讶的是，耍蛇人

sentences.en: suddenly began to play jazz and modern pop songs.
sentences.zh: 突然吹起爵士乐和现代流行歌曲。

sentences.en: The snake, however, continued to 'dance' slowly.
sentences.zh: 然而那条蛇却继续慢慢地“跳舞”。

sentences.en: It obviously could not tell the difference between Indian music and jazz!
sentences.zh: 它显然分辨不出印度音乐和爵士乐的区别！
